guidelines.text: Include a protein source with each meal (eggs, fish, beans, lentils, chicken, yogurt).
Aim ~2–2.5L fluids/day unless your doctor limits fluids.
Add fruits/vegetables and whole grains for fiber; go slow if you have GI issues.
Prioritize colorful vegetables and fruit; include healthy fats (nuts, olive oil).

meal_ideas: Breakfast: eggs + whole grain toast + fruit
Dinner: fish/chicken + rice/whole grains + mixed salad
